Casal de' Pazzi — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Casal de' Pazzi is a largely residential district near the Aniene river, with local shops and a district health facility. The most serious documented incident is a violent home-invasion-style extortion: two young men were lured into an apartment, beaten and held over a debt reportedly linked to drugs, and escaped by climbing between balconies, leading to three arrests by Rome's anti-mafia squad. Police separately seized 10kg of hashish hidden in a home in the area. These are real but isolated, targeted incidents rather than evidence of general street danger, so a green rating applies by day and a cautious yellow at night.
